list.title: Devices
list.description: Manage the devices that connect to your VPN networks

noNetwork.title: No network selected
noNetwork.description: Select a network from the sidebar to view its devices

adminWarning.title: Admin Network Security Warning
adminWarning.body: You are viewing the Admin VPN network (wg0). Devices created in this network will have access to the Admin Panel and internal management services. Only create devices here for trusted administrators. Do not share these configs with regular users.

list.configUnavailable: Config not available for imported devices
list.empty: No devices in this network. Click "Create device" to add one.

delete.title: Delete device
delete.body: Are you sure you want to remove {{name}} from the network? This action cannot be undone.

notFound.title: Device not found
notFound.body: The requested device could not be found or has been deleted.

detail.reconnectHint: If the device does not connect, first click "Restore connection": the server adds back the WireGuard connections this network lost. If that does not help, download the config again and copy it to the device.
detail.reconnectHintViewer: If the device does not connect, ask an operator or admin to restore its connection.
detail.syncResult: Added back: {{added}}; not added (expired, disabled or already connected): {{skipped}}.

create.title: Create new device
create.autoDisableHint: This device will be disabled automatically after the chosen time.
create.adminNetworkHint: This is the Admin VPN network: a device created here gets access to the management panel. Create one only for trusted administrators.

edit.title: Edit: {{name}}
edit.pastExpiryKept: The current expiration is in the past. Extend it, or the device is disabled again.
edit.extendHint: This will extend the current expiration time.
edit.reactivateHint: The device will be reactivated and added back to WireGuard.

errors.mustBeFuture: Expiration date must be in the future!
errors.onlyExtend: Cannot reduce expiration time! You can only extend it.

general.scanHint: Open the WireGuard app and scan

windows.intro: Download and install the official WireGuard client for Windows.

mac.intro: Download WireGuard from the Mac App Store.
mac.import: Click Import tunnel(s) from file in the menu bar.

linux.scriptError: Failed to generate the install script
linux.scriptHint: Run it as root on the new server. It works once, for 15 minutes; generate a new one if it expires.

docker.intro: You can run a WireGuard client easily using Docker. Replace /path/to/wg0.conf with your config path.

traffic.title: Traffic History
traffic.loadError: Traffic history could not be loaded.
traffic.empty: No traffic recorded in this range yet. Samples are taken every 5 minutes.

quota.title: Traffic quota
quota.resetConfirm: Start this device’s quota count again? A block or slow-down is lifted at once.

tunnel.label: Tunnel
tunnel.saved: Saved. Download this device’s config again so it takes effect.
tunnel.pending: Waiting for confirmation in the firewall bar; then download this device’s config again.
